Description.Title: Herron 2022: spontaneous GTPase rosette, WPGAP gradients
Description.Details: Source: Herron et al., PLoS Computational Biology 18:e1010092 (2022), Eqns p5; conserved masses p6; logistic profiles p10; Fig4E-F pp11-12; Table2 p13; initialization and 40 s spot-size simulations p19. The explicit source model is a four-species mass-conserved reaction-diffusion PDE, implemented in Dedalus. This translation uses Cartesian finite differences within an isotropic disk, with reflecting boundaries. No explicit cells occur in the source. One simulation time unit = one second; one physical length unit = one micrometre; all fields in molecules per square micrometre. SpaceSymbol is in lattice nodes, so radius_um explicitly multiplies by dx_um; NodeLength controls diffusion scaling. Morpheus 2.4.1 Circle domains add a two-node buffer without updating SizeSymbol; SpaceSymbol includes that buffer. The domain center is size/2+2, established by raw coordinate fields in attempts/attempt_009. The rate origin subtracts those two nodes to center the IgG disk on the circular boundary, avoiding any biological offset. Spatial rates = minimum + (maximum-minimum)/(1+exp(k*(r-1.75))). This resolves the alpha/beta naming ambiguity in the printed equations using the published source function logistic_decay; the rounded Table2 values are preserved. Basal homogeneous ODE was integrated to 1000 s before initialization. At each site a uniform sample in [0,0.2*v_ss] is converted from v to u, preserving u+v=808. RandomSeed 2022 is an arbitrary reproducibility setting, not a spatial cue. Grid 256x256, dx=0.03125 um; circular domain radius 4 um. Morpheus RK4 with reaction step 0.0025 s and internally scheduled diffusion. Diffusion operator and random-noise discretization differ from Dedalus spectral Fourier-Chebyshev grid; mechanistic geometry and physical units are preserved. CSV interval 0.40404040404040403 s provides 100 samples, including 0 and 40 s. PNG and raw unscaled float-TIFF snapshots at five evenly spaced times.
